basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old from Austin, Texas, with a newfound love for Reddit and its diverse communities. I work as a graphic designer and enjoy exploring niche hobbies in my free time, such as succulent gardening and vertical farming. I also have a thing for classic rock bands like Fleetwood Mac. On weekends, you might find me playing tabletop games like Battletech. I'm single and often online during late evenings, usually after my work commitments are done.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and have been working in graphic design for over 8 years. My interest in succulents and vertical farming started as a hobby but has become a passion through self-teaching and community engagement. I stumbled upon the AgeGap subreddit out of curiosity about how relationships work with significant age differences.
